mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of PAYEMS decrease and UNRATE increase does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month do not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.
